name: File Gate MCP
description: Optional Tool API plugins for gate status, per-file gate lookup, active grants, metrics and single-grant revoke, governed by MCP Sentinel. Read tools never return secret material, file paths or download URLs.
project_description: File Gate MCP exposes File Gate's read-only status/inventory surface and a single incident-response revoke to AI agents through the Tool API, governed by MCP Sentinel. It ships five tools: file_gate_status (whether the gate is real on this site), file_gate_file_gate (which gate applies to one file/media UUID), file_gate_grants_list (active usage-limited grants for a field), file_gate_metrics (mint/delivery/denial counts), and file_gate_grant_revoke (revoke one grant by field + grant id). Read tools are ToolOperation::Read; revoke is ToolOperation::Write and requires a second restricted permission. No tool returns secret material, file paths or download URLs, and results are size-capped by the resolved MCP Sentinel policy profile.
